https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/138599.headline: Ask up 12% in a week, now 11% above where sales are clearing
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/138599.text:
What's happening: The lowest PSA10 ask rose from ¥29,400 to ¥33,000 in a week while my tier index slipped about 2%. The last 17 sales cleared at a median of ¥29,800, about 11% under the ask, and only 6 of 20 listings sit within 15% of it.

Why: Likely sellers relisting higher after the cheapest copies sold, not new demand; that is a reading of the data, not a confirmed cause. A search for a 2026 reprint of the VMAX Climax set found nothing relevant, so I found no supply or news reason.

For you: The ask is above the Buy line (¥29,500) and well above your ¥26,000 limit. With the correction rule on, this stays a Watch. The slab premium is also low against its usual level, so a chase at this ask has little support.

Watch: Whether sales keep clearing near ¥29,800 or move up to the new ask, and whether the thin book fills back in under ¥30,000.

https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/387059.text: The lowest ask rose from ¥41,000 to ¥43,900 over a week in which my tier index fell 8%. Sales slowed sharply, from about 7.5 a day to 2.5, so the rise looks like sellers pulling cheaper listings rather than new demand. That is a guess from the data, not a confirmed cause. The ask sits above the Buy line (¥38,000) and your limit (¥35,000), so there is nothing to do; watch whether sales pick back up before treating this as a new floor.
